segments.text: THomas one of the twelue, whiche is called Didimus, was not with them when Ieſus came. The other diſciples therfore ſayde vnto hym: we haue ſeen the Lord. But he ſayd vnto them: except I ſee in his handes the printe of the nayles, and put my finger into the printe of the nayles, and thruſt my hande into his ſyde, I will not beleue. And after eight dayes, againe his diſciples were within, and Thomas with them. Then came Ieſus when the doores were ſhut, and ſtode in the middes, and ſaied: peace be vnto you. And after that, he ſayed to Thomas: bryng thy finger hither, and ſee my handes, and reache hither thy hande, and thruſt it into my ſyde, and be not faythleſſe, but beleuyng. Thomas aunſwered and ſayed vnto hym: my Lorde and my God. Ieſus ſayed vnto hym: Thomas, becauſe thou haſte ſeen me, thou haſte beleued: bleſſed are they that haue not ſeen, & yet haue beleued. And many other ſygnes truely dyd Ieſus in the preſence of his diſciples, whiche are not written in this booke. Theſe are written that ye myght beleue that Ieſus is Chriſt the ſonne of God, and that (in beleuyng) ye myght haue lyfe through his name.
